services.name: Our E-Bikes
services.desc: We made every Evolve E-Bike a pedal-assist Class 1 e-bike, specifically designed for sharing. Each e-bike comes with a shared helmet and basket so you can take all your gear with you. Our e-bikes are electric pedal assisted, which means they work with you (and won’t take off on their own). The electric motor only kicks in when you’re pedaling, so simply ride Evolve like you would a pedal bike and go ahead and tackle that hill. Evolve has a simple single-gear - no need to shift gears or adjust throttles.
